scope.verdictMeaning: Editorial review only. keep is retention of target/coverage, not certification; merge-candidate may include survivors and requires the stated teaching/link/history safeguards.

methodology.words: All 424 same-written-form families screened by gloss; listed groups inspected with full teaching and contextual excerpts. Unique rare forms retained by mandatory per-word coverage, not certified by a translation re-audit.

functionBatch1.method: All 491 IDs/glosses were screened. Full note/example teaching and source-region context were directly reviewed for the 92 proposed members, with additional catchall/outlier review. Representative source evidence is attached to every member. Exact word IDs were verified for listed occurrence-routing examples. Unlisted cards are not thereby certified correct, and this is not an exhaustive per-token translation revalidation.

functionBatch2.frequentCardContextReview: Samples of up to8 contexts for frequent baselines, plus all contexts for specifically identified mixed pools (word-como, word-del, word-es--fixed-es-que and bien good-experience); not a claim that every frequent occurrence was reviewed.

grammar: Count distinct runtime comics per exact card ID from public/corpus/manifest.json.
Read the full question, answer, note and bilingual example of all 347 grammar cards, not only IDs/glosses.

Compare rare targets to related frequent grammar and selected phrase/word cards; examine occurrence applications for all listed consolidation families (one representative per member reported) plus targeted redundancy checks.
This is a semantic granularity/teaching audit, not a Spanish-source verification of every translation or an exhaustive every-token linkage audit.
Low frequency alone is not grounds for removing a productive construction. Synonymous English glosses do not justify collapsing different Spanish complements, meanings, forms, or agreement patterns.
The keep verdict means no semantic granularity defect was identified in the directly examined teaching, not universal certification of linguistic correctness.

phrase.definition: Appears in one or two distinct manifest.comics[].cardIds sets; not number of word occurrences.
phrase.comparisonScope: All635 phrase cards read in full; grammar inventory screened and relevant candidate definitions/applications read; contextual word glosses checked for suspected redundant phrases.
phrase.semanticVerificationLimits: Read-only corpus audit, not independent RAE/native-speaker validation. Medium-confidence compositional noun-unit removal candidates are editorial judgments; the curriculum explicitly permits conventional collocations. Unflagged keep means justified for retention at this pass, not certified correct.

concept: Manually read all 252 complete public teaching definitions: prompt, question when present, answer, note, example when present, and usage comic IDs.
Read runtime Spanish region text for 76 selected cases, plus linked word-card teaching where useful, to distinguish missing context from explicit plot summary.
Classifications are editorial audit proposals, not curriculum edits or factual certification. No external-source factual re-verification or raster-image QA was performed.

Rarity alone is not a reason for removal: named cultural references and distinct scientific concepts are expected to occur once. Keep means the target is justified, not that every sentence or link is perfect.
Do not indiscriminately merge different named references (Guitar Hero/Rock Band, Vista/ME), mathematical problems (NP-complete/subset-sum/traveling salesperson), or security mechanisms.

scope.purpose: Read-only peer review of 41 word merge proposals and 11 corrections, not implementation or state-migration approval.
scope.basis: Reviewed full teaching of all proposed candidate word IDs and root-provided contextual excerpts; large common-word baseline usage is contextual sampling, not a new exhaustive hotspot relink audit. Focused scrutiny of discovered/hiciera/podría/bonito/flujo/todos/una/no-solo contexts. No external grammar fact-check was requested or performed.
scope.identity: Same written form and contextual sense, not same English translation or same person. Construction-specific information remains in grammar cards/applications.

crossCuttingSafeguards: Do not implement aliases solely from IDs or English glosses; confirm exact occurrence links and the full canonical teaching target.

When two merged IDs already occur in the same comic/session, count that exposure as one binary help outcome while preserving every display/open timestamp. Do not simply add independent success histories.

Mixed-sense IDs requiring a split cannot have all historical learning evidence aliased indiscriminately to each new sense or a single surviving sense. Define a conservative versioning/reconciliation policy before implementation.
Written accents and inflected forms remain distinct even when normalized IDs look similar; conversely unaccented IDs are harmless if the actual prompt and occurrence retain the same accent.

Retaining a broad existing card's note does not itself prove senses are identical. The endorsed state/location proposals rely on an explicit copular-be granularity and preserve auxiliary functions separately.
This review endorses curriculum candidates and boundaries, not an automated global replacement or deletion.

entries.rationale: Identical full teaching and the same attempt sense; retain separately written forms.
Table parts/areas and internet areas use the same part-of-a-whole target; domain belongs in the application.
Accents in IDs do not matter when both printed prompts are había; existential past remains separate from the haber helper.
A direct versus embedded question does not change accented dónde's where meaning.
The liker comes from me/te/les; gusta itself has not changed. Canonical answer must not hard-code I/you/they. Keep different written gustan/gustas and the liking construction distinct.
Same tener form and have sense; possibility and evaluation are different grammar triggers, not separate word targets. A tener razón application must still explain the useful construction.
Same hacer form with do/make sense in PARA QUE ME HICIERA and HICIERA LO QUE HICIERA. Retain both construction lessons and do not make I did the universal shared answer.

Lower high to medium. Imagined available actions (PODRÍA REESTRUCTURAR, PODRÍA DARLE UN PUÑETAZO) and epistemic possibilities (ESTA PODRÍA SER NUESTRA ÚLTIMA NOCHE) are not distinguished only by person. A canonical could/might possibility card is defensible because existing notes already overlap; it must explicitly cover possibility rather than all ability/permission uses. Do not claim this is a purely pronoun-level duplicate.
Wanting remains the lexical target across formal address and se frames; contextual person is not a new quiere sense.
Noun geeks/nerds duplicate; retaining the adjective target is a conservative boundary.
MUCHO MEJOR and MUCHO MÁS share strengthening of a comparison; no arbitrary complement-specific split is needed.
Past wish/intention overlap is already taught by the notes; an unfulfilled intended action does not automatically create a new quería meaning.
Recipient versus no recipient does not change remain/are left; do not also collapse staying/result-state constructions.
The shared doing/making form can appear in ongoing-action and manner constructions; those constructions must retain their separate explanations.

FUE DESCUBIERTO and HAN/HAS DESCUBIERTO share the discovering sense and irregular form. The canonical word card must not imply that haber participles agree with the object or always describe a masculine thing. Retain the contrast between unchanged-after-haber and agreement after ser; descubierto meaning uncovered/exposed would require separate review.
The understood noun supplies one, not interesante. Generic interesting can be shared.
The understood noun supplies ones; lower and plural form remain the same.
Standalone interjection overlaps; verbal vaya and the independently meaningful vaya por Dios phrase remain distinct.
Something/anything choice in questions already belongs to the same unspecified-thing lesson. Do not include amount algo de automatically.
Standalone agreement and predicate both assert truth; certain before a noun is another sense.
Inside-to-outside movement differs only by viewpoint; dating/social going out remains separate.
Supported only after confirming the baseline's occurrences all mean planet Earth, as the root evidence does. Land must not be included in this alias.
DIAGRAMAS DE FLUJO and FLUJO DEL PROGRAMA both concern routes/order through steps. A program is contextual specialization here. Do not extend this to data streams or physical flow.

HE PROBADO CON TODOS includes things; TODOS HEMOS and MATARNOS A TODOS identify a human group including the speaker. Canonical answer should say all (members of the understood group), with everyone as a contextual rendering, not restrict todos to people or hard-code us/them.
One counted feminine item/occasion remains one in UNA HORA, UNA VEZ, and POR UNA VEZ. The phrase supplies for once, not una alone. Keep indefinite article/pronoun uses outside this change.
Ordinary not remains not in no solo; the paired contrast belongs to its existing higher-level construction.
Only remains only in no solo; no supplies negation. The alone/lonely sense must not be folded into it.
Emphatic positive assertion overlaps; optional que is a construction detail. Keep response sí, reflexive sí, and si distinct.

BONITO as a reaction and BONITO REGALO/CÓDIGO/LO BONITO share positive evaluation. Standalone syntax does not justify a new nice-reaction target. Sarcasm or reluctant politeness can be local applications; preserve the separate pretty/cute target in this pass.

The existing broader target already covers being in a location or condition. Consolidation is consistent with this curriculum's copular be granularity; keep progressive helping-verb use separate and do not retain a misleading location-only ID description.
Prueba retains test in poner a prueba; the conventional expression is separately valuable and should not be deleted with the word alias.
Idea versus question/security/practice is arbitrary noun specialization of feminine good. Neither rarity nor English spelling is the sole basis.
Full teaching overlaps in hesitation; attention, confusion, and confirmation functions remain separate.
Normal/ordinary overlaps in the reviewed ordinary-versus-exceptional contexts; no new domain-specific target is necessary.
Formal address is supplied by context and does not change the written está or its state/location sense. Do not fold progressive auxiliary links into this target.
The state-infinitive target already teaches location as well; a shared copular be lesson is consistent with that boundary. This does not authorize merging every estar function or form.
Relative-clause hay still introduces existence/presence; a natural English translation omitting there does not create a Spanish sense. Keep hay que and greeting uses separate.

Manual pages and web pages are defensibly the same written-document unit. Retain medium confidence and the documentation explanation in an application; confirm no occurrence denotes a physical leaf or other separately taught sense.

Retain as an editorial candidate, not an approved first-pass merge. Good at an activity/competent versus good quality is a defensible semantic boundary; shared English good alone is insufficient. The ser bueno + activity construction must remain taught if consolidation is later chosen.

Writing by keyboard and writing a diary can share production of text, but retain medium confidence. The canonical meaning must not become a dictionary bundle including handwriting style, script system, or legal deed.

Defer pending construction-specific review. SIN PARARSE NUNCA and MÁS DAÑO DEL QUE ... PODRÍAS ... NUNCA both translate naturally with ever, but English ever alone does not prove identical licensing. A generic hypothetical-context explanation is too broad; retain separate grammar applications and do not merge ordinary never automatically.

corrections.rationale: Endorse splitting type/kind from guy by exact occurrence; a global alias of a mixed card is unsafe.
Endorse separating literal movement, social ir de marcha, and program operation by occurrence; do not create a broad dictionary to go alias.
Endorse routing location and ongoing-action helping-verb occurrences to their existing exact targets.
Endorse routing estaba deseando to the ongoing-action helper before consolidating same-form state uses across persons.
Endorse further occurrence-level review. Remaining amount and staying/resulting state must not be collapsed merely because English remain fits both.
Endorse removing the unsupported stopped gloss from the volume-left-low occurrence and retaining dejé de separately.
Endorse service-down meaning rather than physical falling; avoid a cross-sense alias.
Endorse removing older from the greatest-adventures card while preserving the age sense.
Endorse generalizing size beyond budget; major/excellent require their own sense decisions.
Endorse broad cause/make lexical meaning with causing-an-action versus causing-a-state construction applications retained.
Endorse moving chart-specific copy out of the shared ordinary bad card; keep the word card compact.

additionalGrammarFindings.detail: Stored grammar/phrase labels have not prevented duplicate scheduler identities for the same target, notably algo de, tardar en, and llamar naming.
Higher-order cards built from an existing word/grammar card plus normal negation, adjective agreement, or a routine noun omission often add scheduling identities without adding a new recall target.
Archaic future subjunctive, negative vosotros commands, diminutives, age-with-tener, weekday articles, and the perception gerund/infinitive contrast remain legitimate even at one comic.

The sin+noun+alguno invented example currently lacks sin; the suggested broader negative-alguno survivor naturally covers that example. Some rare cards have undefined terminology or too little explanation; rewrite verdicts identify these without implying they should be deleted.
Question-words already explains embedded-question accents while grammar-indirect-question-accent schedules that subtype separately; both are frequent and deserve a later broader normalization check.
